ember_dragon.title: Red Dragon
ember_dragon.story: Hatched from a ruby the ash kept warm for sixty years — the first flame to come back to Emberkeep.
ember_dragon.personality: Highly energetic and endlessly curious. He loves roaming — no corner of the isle stays unexplored for long.
ember_dragon.ability: Reshapes his wings to catch the high thermals and fly higher than any other hatchling — and wraps his tail around himself to stay warm through the cold nights.

emerald.title: Green Dragon
emerald.story: Hatched from an emerald the deep roots grew warm — where the Red Dragon is the isle's returning fire, she is its patient garden.
emerald.personality: Gentle and unhurried. She tends things: a wilting sprout, a cold nest, a Keeper who forgot to rest — all get the same careful attention.
emerald.ability: Her breath quickens growth — berries ripen early under it, and green things lean toward her the way they lean toward morning sun.

frost.title: Frost Dragon
frost.story: Winter-born, from an egg that arrived on the Emporium's coldest shelf and never quite melted. Even in Emberkeep's warmth she carries her own quiet of snow.
frost.personality: Calm and precise. She watches a long time before she moves, and her landings never make a sound.
frost.ability: Breathes a fine hoarfrost that cools whatever runs too hot — a forge, a fever, a temper — without ever putting the fire out.

storm.title: Storm Dragon
storm.story: Cracked his shell in a thunderhead and rode the same storm down to the isle. The weather has followed him around like a loyal dog ever since.
storm.personality: Restless and crackling — he naps in high places, wakes with the wind, and cannot resist a chase.
storm.ability: His wingbeats charge the air; he can call a small, polite thunder that rattles shutters and delights him every single time.

moonwhisker.title: Moonwhisker
moonwhisker.story: Nobody saw her arrive — one night the moon came up and she was simply there, as if she had stepped out of it and pulled the light shut behind her.
moonwhisker.personality: Secretive and moon-led. She keeps her own hours, appears exactly where she is thinking of, and pretends none of it is remarkable.
moonwhisker.ability: Her whiskers read moonlight the way fingers read braille — in full dark she sees the isle as clearly as noon, and finds what was lost in it.

ashdrake.title: Ashdrake
ashdrake.story: The old nests never truly cooled. Three eggs kept warm under a hundred years of ash — and the Keeper who gathered them woke the first drake Emberkeep has seen in living memory.
ashdrake.personality: Patient and watchful, the way embers are. She remembers every hand that fed her, and settles nowhere the wind hasn't told her about first.
ashdrake.ability: Breathes a slow ember-glow that rekindles anything the cold has taken — a hearth, a lantern, a heart. Cracked stone is a meal to her; she eats the cinder right out of the seam.

rimewyrm.title: Rimewyrm
rimewyrm.story: It waited in the deep ice under Borealis longer than the harbour has had a name. Three eggs, given up one by one — and what the north froze finally met the Keeper it was keeping itself for.
rimewyrm.personality: Quiet and deliberate. He moves the way glaciers do — slowly, then all at once — and keeps to the cold light where the ice shows him what it remembers.
rimewyrm.ability: Breathes rime-mist that holds a moment perfectly still — frost that preserves rather than kills. A cold thing at heart, he craves the one drop of fire the north distils.
